prose: The Guardian reports that Mumsnet denied using AI to produce content after a detailed AI prompt appeared as a reply on one of its 'am I being unreasonable' posts. The prompt, titled AIBU Response Schema v.1.0, told a model to write a forum-style ruling with brief actionable advice, and defined forum abbreviations.

Users called it creepy and disappointing and rejected the site's explanations; one said they might as well do something else. The site, founded in 2000, had a 19% fall in monthly unique users in 2025 to 6.1 million. The article does not establish who posted the prompt.
highlights: AI prompt appeared as a reply on a Mumsnet post
Prompt asked for a forum-style ruling and advice
Mumsnet denies using AI for content
Who posted the prompt is not established
